summary: DeepSeek-V4-Pro Max approved the P4 proof-security boundary with zero blocking findings. HypothesisOffer binds frozen ProgramProofIR, ProofObligation, clauses and EvidenceAction values before the one-call tool-free Hunter runs. The model can only select offered identifiers; strict report and content-hash validation reject free parameters, unknown, duplicate, cross-offer, cross-obligation and tampered data. The P2 Checker recomputes predicates from frozen IR and fails closed on incomplete coverage. Only complete programmatic confirmation may enter the separate force-unconfirmed shadow ledger, which has no path to live validation or terminal authority.

non_blocking_findings.title: Future multi-clause selected-action closure must treat unselected executable clauses as unknown
non_blocking_findings.evidence: ProofKernelEngine evaluates only selected action IDs. The current P4 catalog and qualification create exactly one confirmation clause and no counterproof/open clause, so subset evaluation is currently equivalent to full evaluation and remains shadow-only.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Before P5 or any multi-clause producer, require a check result for every executable clause before returning confirmed; otherwise return needs_review.

non_blocking_findings.title: Static Hunter instructions use the literal word candidate
non_blocking_findings.evidence: The instruction says not to invent candidate state, while all runtime projection data is still recursively candidate-blind and contains no candidate identity or verdict.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: For a mechanically literal prompt-hygiene check, consider neutral wording such as selection state before P5.

non_blocking_findings.title: Production wiring intentionally omits live covered-key and alias-root inputs
non_blocking_findings.evidence: The runtime relies on local structural unit identity and exact content-bound cache reuse, avoiding a live-candidate data edge but re-planning after relevant input drift.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Document this P4 isolation choice and introduce only non-candidate structural alias roots if P5 requires stronger cross-run reuse.

non_blocking_findings.title: Hunter coverage_status is advisory
non_blocking_findings.evidence: The report accepts complete, partial or failed as a selection-process self-report; runtime registration ignores it and depends only on Checker closure.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Document the field as non-authoritative or derive it programmatically before P5.

checks.name: candidate identity and clean worktree
checks.evidence: Git resolved the assigned commit and tree exactly and reported a clean worktree.

checks.name: system-generated offer, action and obligation binding
checks.evidence: validate_hypothesis_offer and validate_security_hypothesis bind obligation, IR, clause, subject, region, defect family, dependency hashes and content-derived IDs.

checks.name: invalid selection rejection
checks.evidence: The report validator and selected-action entry reject extra parameters, missing/duplicate/unknown IDs, cross-offer actions and references outside the offer.

checks.name: offline Checker recomputation
checks.evidence: ProofChecker re-evaluates the predicate from frozen ProgramProofIR and checks identity, code/IR/backend/dependency hashes, witness, coverage, assumptions and fixed parameters.

checks.name: open and incomplete coverage remains unknown
checks.evidence: Open clauses produce no executable action, incomplete coverage cannot yield an accepted fact, and closure remains needs_review until all required confirmation clauses are accepted.

checks.name: programmatic conflict and terminal decision
checks.evidence: Confirmation/counterproof conflict is resolved in ProofKernelEngine and model output has no terminal disposition field.

checks.name: zero later call after cluster proof
checks.evidence: Planner investigation roots are scheduled once; runtime calls report_runner at most once per unit and exact replay is a cache hit with no new model call.

checks.name: shadow ledger authority isolation
checks.evidence: A separate CandidateLedger with decision_trace_store=None receives only force-unconfirmed shadow issues and is frozen into an independent CAS; live authority packages do not import it.

checks.name: single terminal event and alert replay
checks.evidence: DecisionTrace attaches refs to the existing terminal event and alert verification only loads a validated frozen identity with active_product_effect=none.

checks.name: CAS, cache and dependency tamper resistance
checks.evidence: The P4 store validates object filenames, content hashes, dependency refs, cycles, root refs, shadow-ledger hash and cache identity; tampering falls back to an empty shadow identity.

checks.name: candidate-blind Unicode and case resistance
checks.evidence: Projection keys and scalars are NFKC/casefold normalized, prohibited identifiers are rejected, and serialized JSON is checked again before the agent call.

checks.name: answer-free qualification
checks.evidence: The deterministic 120-case artifact has zero safe/near-miss false registration, 100 percent contract resolution, three replayable projects and separated source/expected inputs unavailable to product runtime.

checks.name: no pre-P5 authority or Benchmark edge
checks.evidence: Lifecycle and package gates fix shadow/none, reject config authority switches, and forbid Benchmark, truth, Scorer, reporting and live-validation imports.

limitations: The three historical P0 aggregate artifacts are absent and were not used in the decision.

The DSH read-only sandbox could not independently rerun tmp-path-dependent pytest or rebuild the wheel; exact-candidate local results were corroborated from code, tests, gates and the frozen artifact.
Range truth/fixtures, benchmark ground truth and Scorer inputs were not read; no benchmark was executed.
This review is limited to P4 proof security; product architecture was reviewed independently.
attestation: DeepSeek-V4-Pro Max, running in DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 with reasoning_effort=max and permission_mode=read-only, reviewed commit cc0e25f1fa34f0d9234f108a7d8fd22aa772ee58 and tree 71a63eb25fbf6d5c65f1294fa948caa88b64f026. It made no file or Git changes, read no Range truth/fixture/Scorer input, and ran no external benchmark. Decision: approved with zero blocking findings.
